name: South Fork Snake (Canyon)
blurb: South Fork Snake canyon and downstream valley floats, with public access at Conant, Fullmer, Byington and Lorenzo. Choose the full canyon or a shorter reach through Fullmer.

sections.notes: A long canyon float. Fullmer at river mile 28 provides an intermediate public ramp; arrange your shuttle and allow time for stops. Use designated camps and the required overnight permit if breaking the trip over multiple days.

distanceEvidence.streamId: South Fork Snake / agency river miles from Palisades Dam

notices.title: Plan your access and overnight arrangements
notices.text: Launch at designated sites and check current facility fees, road conditions and closures. Overnight camping requires the self-issued permit and designated camps; follow the river’s waste and fire rules.
notices.sourceName: BLM — South Fork Snake boating regulations

putInAccess.operator: Bureau of Land Management — Upper Snake Field Office
putInAccess.sourceName: BLM — South Fork Snake public access and boating regulations
putInAccess.note: BLM public GIS identifies the Conant facility at the parking/staging area. Imagery and BLM river-mile map agree on this location. Reject the visit-page coordinate near Spring Creek; do not snap this staging point to a guessed shoreline landing.
putInAccess.directions: Follow Conant Valley Loop to the signed Conant boat access. Concrete-boat and raft launch areas are separate. Confirm your chosen launch or takeout and use the designated parking.

takeOutAccess.operator: Bureau of Land Management — Upper Snake Field Office
takeOutAccess.sourceName: BLM — South Fork Snake public access and boating regulations
takeOutAccess.note: BLM public GIS point lies on the concrete ramp apron in imagery; the agency visit page confirms a concrete ramp and separate raft facilities. This identifies the ramp, not a surveyed seasonal water edge.
takeOutAccess.directions: Follow the signed Byington boat-access road from the Swan Valley Highway. Use the designated concrete ramp or separate raft facility and arrange a shuttle before launching.

sections.notes: A shorter canyon option ending at the public Fullmer ramp. Confirm the Fullmer road and shuttle beforehand; its map marker is the parking area above the river.

sections.notes: Launch at Fullmer for the lower canyon reach to Byington. Confirm road access and your shuttle before launching, and identify the designated Byington ramp or raft exit.
